newsitem.title: USA: Data General Corp introduces new servers.
newsitem.headline: Data General Corp introduces new servers.

text.p: Data General Corp on Monday introduced two new servers, one aimed at the high-end enterprise computing market and the other priced to attract low-cost departmental users.

The high-end server, the AViiON AV 6600, has six Pentium Pro processors. Its pricing starts at under $70,000, or under $50,000 with only three processors, and the product is now available, Data General said.
The other new server, the AV 2100, has one or two Pentium Pros. It will be available in 30 days, with an estimated street price of $4,200, the company said.

Data General said that either new server can be used in clustered configurations. The company said its NT Cluster in a Box product can handle two AV 6600 systems with a total of 12 Pentium Pro processors or two AV 2100 systems with four Pentium Pros in a single rackmounted configuration.
For UNIX applications, Data General said it can cluster up to four AV 6600 servers.
Data General specializes in servers, storage systems and related software and services.
